description: Full-text search across all 50 titles of the US Code of Federal Regulations (federal agency regulations) via the official eCFR API. Returns matching sections with citation, heading, and excerpt. e.g. "drone operation", "food labeling", "overtime pay". Optionally restrict to one CFR title number. Keyless.

query.description: Search phrase, e.g. "drone operation", "food labeling", "overtime pay", "hazardous waste".

title.description: Optional CFR title number (1–50) to restrict the search to. Use list_titles to see the title index, e.g. 14 = Aeronautics and Space, 21 = Food and Drugs, 29 = Labor.

name: search_regulations
title: Search Regulations
